verdict.rationale: Antigravity's built-in agent is the core of the product. The docs show you can tell agents what you need in natural language and they work on it autonomously across editor, terminal and browser, delegate to built-in subagents, run several agents in parallel, and halt for approval through plan Artifacts. Community users confirm the product and its CLI agent work in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence on how well delegated tasks are actually completed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Tell your agents what you need, and they’ll work on getting it done.
Able to autonomously operate across your editor, terminal, and browser.
Antigravity comes pre-packaged with several specialized subagents out of the box
Google Antigravity's Editor view offers tab autocompletion, natural language code commands, and a configurable, and context-aware configurable agent.
Now, I'll do the same with Antigravity CLI and vscode. It works fine.
